ignore_list: Don't build Android/iOS native apps yet** - need proven web demand before spending months on app stores with zero organic discovery
Don't add forums, chat, or community features** - no audience to populate them, creates ghost-town effect
Don't redesign the UI or add animations** - this is a distribution problem, not a product problem; existing users can navigate fine
Don't buy Google/Facebook ads** - can't outspend established brands with their CPCs; bootstrap with SEO first
Don't pursue cricket board partnerships or official licenses** - 6+ month sales cycles that may never close
Don't build historical stats archives or player career pages** - people come for live action, not encyclopedia content
Don't add video highlights or clips** - expensive bandwidth with no users to watch them yet
Don't implement user accounts or personalization** - adds friction before you know what features matter
recommendation.direction: Become the clean, fast alternative that appears when cricket fans search for the specific live match they're watching.
